title: Write your own hooks
hints: useToggle: const [on, setOn] = useState(initial); return [on, () => setOn((previous) => !previous)];
useCounter: return { count, increment: () => setCount((c) => c + step), ... }
useLocalStorage: start with useState(() => { const stored = localStorage.getItem(key); return stored === null ? initial : JSON.parse(stored); })
Then save in an effect: useEffect(() => { localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value)); }, [key, value]);
